title: Personal Knowledge & PKM Quarter-over-Quarter Volume Shift
dataSources: Obsidian graph stats (`obsidian:stats`), Roam daily notes (`roam:daily`), Logseq tasks (`logseq:task`), Zettelkasten notes (`zettel:note`), PKM review summaries (`pkm:review`).
app: Obsidian graph stats, Roam daily notes, Logseq task exports, and Zettelkasten counts streamed to Splunk HEC via plugins, CSV exports, and scripted vault scans.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:stats
| bin _time span=1q
| stats count as events by _time
| streamstats current=f last(events) as prev_q by _time
| eval qoq_pct=round(100*(events-prev_q)/prev_q,1)
| where isnotnull(prev_q) AND prev_q>0
| sort - _time
description: Compares event volume quarter over quarter for personal knowledge telemetry in index=personal.
value: Seasonal life domains swing a lot; a quarter view separates real habit change from normal summer/winter noise without overreacting to one bad week.
implementation: Keep `obsidian:stats` events flowing into `index=personal` with stable timestamps, then review QoQ percent change during quarterly personal ops reviews.
visualization: Column chart of events by quarter with QoQ percent labels.
grandmaExplanation: It keeps how much your personal knowledge activity changed compared with last quarter so you can tell a real shift from normal seasonal ups and downs.
